newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia cottonseed plant officially opened.
newsitem.headline: Australia cottonseed plant officially opened.

text.p: Australian agri-products group Chalmers Ltd on Monday opened a cottonseed packing plant in Brisbane as the first stage of a containerisation project.

The facility was opened as cotton growers in southeast Queensland and northeast New South Wales celebrated a near-record harvest with 2.5 million 500 pound bales a distinct possibility, Queensland Deputy Premier Joan Sheldon, who opened the facility, said in a statement. The new plant packed more than 200 containers of cottonseed last month, she said.
The purpose-built complex is the first stage of a A$2 million containerisation complex proposed by Chalmers for the Brisbane site, Sheldon said.

Chalmers announced in December that it and Globex International Pty Ltd were entering into a handling, storage, packing and bagging facility joint-venture for cottonseed and bulk commodities, with total initial capital commitment set at about A$4.0 million.
